SOM.note: Only Puntland census data publication mentioned; subnational, no national census stated.
No ICT employment or graduate unemployment figure stated.
Names the 2018 Somalia Open Government Initiative and data.gov.so but no adopted open data policy.

facts.fact: Bareedo Platform reports that the Federal Ministry of Finance and Puntland's Ministry of Finance publicly released income and expenditure reports, driven by World Bank-supported financial reforms.
facts.system: Ministry of Finance income and expenditure reports

facts.fact: Bareedo Platform, a Somali civil-society and think-tank organisation, hosted the Somalia Open Data Day conference in Garowe on 5 March 2025 where its researcher presented a study of the open data landscape.

SOM.note: Open-data conference names no digital law or policy put to outside participants.
